notes.title: The Return of Enchantress!
notes.content:
Hello All! I just wanted to say again a big thank you to all that supported, downloaded and purchased the game with all its  efforts in passing as my Final University Project!. It has been a tough few months of study recovery, but now I am ready to carry on finshing this "could be Masterpiece". ːsteammockingː

 just a quick message in regards to the further development plans on Enchantress. I am currently as mentioned on my Tumblr page, starting to clean  up the project before fixing bugs and updating the content. 

Once project is clean, I'll start outlining the known and hidden bugs throughout the game which will be prioritised in the weeks to come. 

I intend to keep you all posted with ongoing development videos and regular posts for any changes. 

Stay tuned!! - VampireViktor20

notes.title: Developer Message
notes.content:
Hello All! 

First of all, I'd like to thank every one who has taken the time and consideration to download Enchantress and hope you all found it enlightening, even in it's current playable state. The few reviews I have recieved have been helpful. I think it is very easy to say, Yes it is BUGGY. although it is about looking beyond the smoothness and into the theory behind this experience. 

Enchantress development will be until further notice as being a university project, I enjoyed the highs and lows of indie game development. It will take alot of time and effort to meet the finalsied product that you will all grow to love. I will be updating in the near future when progress has arisen! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37780036/fb0b6a8e07ba885b07bb4c71a5668ff3b589650f.png[/img]

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Enchantress Beta Release Date
notes.content:
Greetings all! just a quick update to those of you who can't wait to play.  Fear not! I have completed the Beta version to the best of its performance. It was going to release on the 29th but due to steam publishing guidelines it will be realeasing 2nd/3rd June.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37780036/f8db6dc9799d4cfa3bf29c1a38b444dec542e0c9.png[/img]

The game is at hand!  you will be immersed as much as possible with seeing the passion I had developing Enchantress. See you all Soon!
